_about: 秘境 per map: from = the area it is reached from, dir = which side's high ground, spots = indices of that area's gathering spots (data/gather.json, same in every rank) that are in the 秘境; no spots = not matched yet; low = also reached in 下位 (otherwise 上位 and up only, so the 下位 tables in the source data are unreachable). Hand-written.
